2610.09920.title: Inverting Multi-Vector Visual Document Indices
2610.09920.paper_summary: Prevailing multi-vector visual document retrievers store each page as about a thousand patch vectors, often in vector databases run by a third party. Since no one can read a page from its vectors, this index is easily treated as less sensitive than the page. However, because the index keeps one vector per patch in raster order, and each vector is computed by a vision-language model pre-trained to read documents, we hypothesize that whoever runs or breaches the store can reproduce a page from its index alone. We frame inversion as conditional document image generation and infer from the vectors what the attack needs: the encoder, the page shape and, for shuffled vectors, their order. On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, pages inverted from raw indices recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens. Used as queries against the stored indices, they rank their source page first 98.4% of the time. We test two cheap protections, token pooling and shuffling, which both cut word recall to about 8%. A model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, while inverting a pooled index remains open. To test generalisation, we apply the same attack unchanged to another multi-vector retriever: its inverted pages still rank their source page first 70.2% of the time, though its word recall stays below a nearest-neighbour baseline. Multi-vector visual document retrievers are therefore vulnerable to inversion through their stored index, which should be protected like the documents it encodes.
2610.09920.paper_summary_zh: 主流的多向量視覺文檔檢索器將每頁存儲為約一千個補丁向量，通常在第三方運行的向量數據庫中。由於沒有人能從其向量中讀取頁面，因此這個索引通常被視為不如頁面敏感。然而，由於該索引以光柵順序保持每個補丁的一個向量，且每個向量是由預訓練的視覺-語言模型計算出來以讀取文檔，我們假設無論誰運行或入侵該存儲，都可以僅從其索引重建一頁。我們將反演框架定義為條件文檔圖像生成，並從向量中推斷攻擊所需的內容：編碼器、頁面形狀，以及對於打亂的向量，它們的順序。在 ViDoRe v3 基準測試中，從原始索引反演的頁面恢復了 47% 的單詞和 45% 的敏感標記。用作對存儲索引的查詢時，它們在 98.4% 的時間內將其來源頁面排名第一。我們測試了兩種廉價的保護措施，標記池化和打亂，這兩者都將單詞回憶降低到約 8%。一個恢復打亂索引順序的模型將來源頁面排名第一的比例從 3.8% 提高到 93.5%，而對於池化索引的反演仍然是開放的。為了測試泛化，我們將相同的攻擊不變地應用於另一個多向量檢索器：其反演頁面仍然在 70.2% 的時間內將其來源頁面排名第一，儘管其單詞回憶仍低於最近鄰基準。因此，多向量視覺文檔檢索器對其存儲的索引存在反演的脆弱性，這應該像編碼的文檔一樣受到保護。
